visionStrategy.statement: Delivering complex infrastructure projects safely, on time, and with high quality while navigating economic headwinds through value-engineering partnerships.

aiStrategyBrief.recommendation: Position as a 'Value-Engineering Partner' focusing on TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and safety compliance. Target procurement leads for the Godrej Golf Course Road luxury project and the new Bangalore senior living facility.

signals.title: Luxury Residential Expansion
signals.description: ₹1,100 crore contract with Godrej Properties for luxury developments in Gurugram.

signals.title: Senior Living Entry
signals.description: New foray into senior living in Bangalore requiring specialized low-VOC and anti-microbial coatings.

latestNews.headline: Tata Projects Secures ₹1,100 Crore Godrej Contract
latestNews.summary: Tata Projects awarded core and shell construction for luxury residential projects in Gurugram.
latestNews.details: The project involves high-end residential infrastructure, creating demand for premium exterior and architectural coatings.

latestUpdates.updateText: Focus shifting toward high-margin, high-value partnerships to mitigate rising construction costs.
